pages.text: A frame is the base of your automobile: its shape and its $(bold)Weight$(). Lighter frames accelerate faster but handle worse under load; heavier frames are steadier but slower off the line.

pages.title: Where to Craft
pages.text: All frames are crafted in the $(l:getting_started/auto_mechanic_table)Auto Mechanic Table$(), under the Frames category. Recipes range from a simple Wooden Motorcar to tractors, rickshaws and novelty shapes like the Shopping Cart and Pineapple.

pages.title: Available Frames
pages.text: Wooden, Copper, Steel, Golden and Bejeweled Motorcars$(br)Standard frames in every dye color$(br)Amethyst, Quartz, Prismarine and Echo Rickshaws$(br)Red, Yellow, Green and Blue Tractors$(br)Shopping Cart and Pineapple
